caption: The drawing depicts a full-length statue of a standing figure with brown skin, long dark hair, and an elaborately decorated outfit. The figure wears a red tunic with a yellow border, over which is draped a pale blue cloak featuring a textured, fringed detail. Atop the head is a yellow band with large, upright feathers in shades of pink, blue, and yellow arranged in a fan-like pattern. The figure stands barefoot on a rectangular, gray base that shows lines suggesting cracks. The left hand holds a bundle wrapped in red fabric while the right hand holds a cylindrical object. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the figure and the pedestal it stands on.
title: Cigar Store Indian
